summary: Targeted bug-fix validation for Create Project workflow (404 regression). Verified backend POST /api/projects returns 200 with an id, GET lists the project (persistence), DELETE cleans up. Verified the frontend UI flow end-to-end via Playwright against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL: opened Project Selector -> 'New project', empty-name submit shows 'Project name is required' (no React runtime error), filled name/description and submitted -> POST /api/projects returned 200, success toast 'TEST_ui_create created' displayed, app navigated to '/', new project became active in the top-bar selector and appeared in Recent projects. No 404 observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Consider persisting an 'is_active' flag server-side or exposing an /api/projects/active endpoint; currently active project is only client-side state.
CreateProjectDialog does not appear to clear/reset form fields after successful create; low priority.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 TEST_ projects during testing (TEST_bugfix via curl, TEST_ui_create via UI). Both deleted via DELETE /api/projects/{id}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified. REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://forge-studio-core.preview.emergentagent.com is correctly used by the running frontend. Create Project flow (top-bar selector -> new-project-menu-item -> project-submit-btn) works: POST returns 200, toast shown, navigates to '/', selector updates. Empty name validation works.
rca of the issue: Root cause was a stale REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL baked into the previously-running dev bundle after the preview URL changed. Fix by main agent (restart frontend + hardened CreateProjectDialog with try/catch, id validation, and navigate('/')) is effective. Reproduction now impossible: network log shows POST going to the current REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and receiving 200.
